Through the present petition, the petitioner seeks direction to the learned Trial Court to conclude the trial in expeditious/speedy manner in CR. Case 3036/2018 pertaining to the FIR no. 307/2017 registered at Police Station Alipur for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Issue notice.
Learned ASC for State, who appears on advance notice, accepts notice and seeks time to file status report.

3. Let the same be filed three days prior to the next date of hearing.
4.
It has been observed that the complainant has not been arrayed as a party in the present matter.
5. At this juncture, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks some time to file amended memo of parties.
Let the same be filed within two weeks from
